description: Ceremony floor by work profile. The work modes (organic / spec / receipt) are the vocabulary; this policy is what makes them enforceable. A project that declares profiles.work turns the matching requirements into `se validate --project` failures. A project that declares no work profile keeps the defaults (nothing required), so adoption and unprofiled projects stay valid.
notes: spec_required: an SDD in sdds/ must reach a status in spec_status_acceptable.
receipt_required: at least one RDD in rdds/ must carry a verdict in receipt_verdicts_acceptable.
Every value listed here must exist in the matching schema enum (SCHEMAS/sdd status, SCHEMAS/rdd verdict); TESTS/test_ceremony.py enforces it.
The work mode is chosen from the profile (type/scale/risk + criticality + contract change), never by habit; see DOCS/reference/work-modes.md.
